messages.content: Revise the Arabic translation against its English source. Correct grammar, spelling, meaning, and awkward wording while preserving every detail. Use clear, faithful Modern Standard Arabic. Do not add notes. Return exactly one Arabic translation for each input, in the same order and with identical chapter and verse values. Output JSON only with book_code and verses[{chapter,verse,text_ar}]. No Latin letters.

{"units":[{"source_text":"And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and God created man in his own image.","source_ref":"1:1","chapter":1,"current_translation":"وقال الله: لنصنع الإنسان على صورتنا، على شبهنا، فخلق الله الإنسان على صورته الخاصة.","verse":1},{"source_text":"And God formed man from the ground, and he blew into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul endowed with speech.","source_ref":"1:2","chapter":1,"current_translation":"فشكل الله الإنسان من التراب، ونفخ في أنفه نسمة الحياة، فأصبح الإنسان نفسًا حيةً متمكنةً من الكلام.","verse":2},{"source_text":"And the Lord said, It is not good for man to be alone; I will make unto him a helpmeet.","source_ref":"1:3","chapter":1,"current_translation":"وقال الرب: ليس من الجيد أن يكون الإنسان وحيدًا؛ سأصنع له معاونًا.","verse":3},{"source_text":"And the Lord caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept, and he took away one of his ribs, and he built flesh upon it, and formed it and brought it to Adam, and Adam awoke from his sleep, and behold a woman was standing before him.","source_ref":"1:4","chapter":1,"current_translation":"وأسقط الرب نومًا عميقًا على آدم، فنام، فأخذ إحدى أضلاعه، فصنع لحمًا عليها، وشكّلها وأحضرها إلى آدم، فاستفاق آدم من نومه فوجد امرأة تقف أمامه.","verse":4},{"source_text":"And he said, This is a bone of my bones and it shall be called woman, for this has been taken from man; and Adam called her name Eve, for she was the mother of all living.","source_ref":"1:5","chapter":1,"current_translation":"فقال: هذه عظم من عظامي وتدعى امرأة، لأنها أُخذت من رجل؛ فسمى آدمُها حواء، لأنها أم جميع الأحياء.","verse":5},{"source_text":"And God blessed them and called their names Adam and Eve in the day that he created them, and the Lord God said, Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.","source_ref":"1:6","chapter":1,"current_translation":"باركهم الله ودعا اسميهما آدم وحواء في اليوم الذي خلقهما فيه، وقال رب الله: اثراوا وتكاثروا واملأوا الأرض.","verse":6},{"source_text":"And the Lord God took Adam and his wife, and he placed them in the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it; and he commanded them and said unto them, From every tree of the garden you may eat, but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.","source_ref":"1:7","chapter":1,"current_translation":"وأخذ رب الله آدم وزوجته، ووضعهما في جنّة عدن ليعملوا فيها ويحافظوا عليها؛ فأمرهما وقال لهما: من كل شجرة في الجنة تأكلون، لكن من شجرة معرفة الخير والشر لا تأكلون، ففي اليوم الذي تأكلون فيها ستموتون بالتأكيد.","verse":7},{"source_text":"And when God had blessed and commanded them, he went from them, and Adam and his wife dwelt in the garden according to the command which the Lord had commanded them.","source_ref":"1:8","chapter":1,"current_translation":"وعندما باركهم الله وأمرهم، رحل عنهم، فكان آدم وزوجته يسكنان الجنة وفقًا للأمر الذي أصدره الرب لهما.","verse":8},{"source_text":"And the serpent, which God had created with them in the earth, came to them to incite them to transgress the command of God which he had commanded them.","source_ref":"1:9","chapter":1,"current_translation":"فجاء الثعبان، الذي خلقه الله معهم على الأرض، إليهما ليحثهما على خرق أمر الله الذي أوصاهما به.","verse":9},{"source_text":"And the serpent enticed and persuaded the woman to eat from the tree of knowledge, and the woman hearkened to the voice of the serpent, and she transgressed the word of God, and took from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and she ate, and she took from it and gave also to her husband and he ate.","source_ref":"1:10","chapter":1,"current_translation":"فأغرى الثعبان المرأة لتأكل من شجرة المعرفة، واستجابت المرأة لصوت الثعبان، فخالفت كلمة الله، فأخذت من شجرة معرفة الخير والشر فأكلت، ثم أخذت منها وأعطتها لزوجها فأكل هو أيضًا.","verse":10}],"book_code":"JASHER"}
